phase: Sovereign Yield Response — Structural Selection Preregistration
purpose: Preregister a parsimonious quarterly conditional-yield selection cycle before any coefficient estimation, using only the exact retained sovereign-yield source vintage. The cycle tests predictive incremental value of lagged fiscal state variables beyond persistence and common-market controls; it does not identify causal fiscal effects and does not activate a System Dynamics feedback loop.

target.concept: Romania 10-year long-term convergence yield in RON
target.interpretation: Yield level only. The Germany series is a common long-rate control; no RON-EUR differential is called a pure sovereign credit spread.

information_timing.common_market_controls: Contemporaneous quarter t values are allowed for Germany 10Y and New CISS. Evaluation is therefore a conditional quarterly yield prediction/nowcast, not a real-time forecast made before quarter-t market information exists.
information_timing.fiscal_controls: Debt-to-GDP and B9-to-GDP enter only at t-1. Same-quarter fiscal observations are prohibited in the first cycle.
information_timing.target_lag: Romania yield t-1 is available to autoregressive baseline and candidate.

domestic_policy_rate_decision.reason: The retained validation-recovery BIS policy-rate normalized series is reconciled, but its original historical raw transport payload is not exactly recoverable under the repository source-vintage contract. Adding it would break exact byte-level provenance for this new cycle.
domestic_policy_rate_decision.reopen_rule: A later independently preregistered cycle may add a domestic policy-rate control only after a definitionally matched exact raw source vintage is retained and a quarterly aggregation rule is frozen before fit.

baseline_models.role: strong non-fiscal conditional benchmark using yield persistence, the common long-rate control and external financial stress

candidate_models.equation: y_RO[t] = alpha + rho*y_RO[t-1] + beta_g*y_DE[t] + beta_s*CISS[t] + beta_d*DebtGDP[t-1] + beta_b*B9GDP[t-1]

fiscal_parameter_interpretation.beta_d: incremental association of prior-quarter Maastricht debt-to-GDP with the conditional Romania 10Y yield; expected non-negative
fiscal_parameter_interpretation.beta_b: incremental association of prior-quarter B9 net lending (+)/net borrowing (-) with the conditional Romania 10Y yield; expected non-positive because more positive B9 is a stronger fiscal balance

fitting_method.missing_value_policy: No imputation. A target quarter is evaluable only when every required current and lagged input is finite.

windows.structural_selection_method: Expanding-origin one-step conditional predictions. At each target quarter, fit each estimable model using only earlier target quarters; quarter-t Germany yield and CISS may enter the prediction because this is a conditional nowcast.
windows.final_evaluation_open_rule: Open final-evaluation model performance only if the fiscal-augmented candidate passes every structural-selection and identifiability gate. If it fails, final-evaluation performance remains unopened and cannot rescue the form.

identifiability_gates.rule: Failure of rank, condition-number or domain consistency is an identification failure. Do not rescue the candidate with ridge/lasso, variable deletion, lag search or sign flipping inside this cycle.

structural_selection_gates.rule: The fiscal-augmented candidate passes only if every identifiability and predictive gate passes. Improvement over persistence alone is insufficient; incremental value over the non-fiscal common-market AR baseline is mandatory.

final_evaluation_gates_if_opened.parameter_refit_policy: At each final-evaluation origin, refit the frozen model form only on data strictly earlier than that target quarter; no form, lag, variable or gate may change.
final_evaluation_gates_if_opened.sensitivity: For the final origin fit, perturb each free coefficient independently by ±10%; no perturbation may more than double final-evaluation RMSE relative to the unperturbed frozen-form path.

robustness_diagnostics_not_selection_cri.note: Diagnostics may motivate a future separately preregistered cycle but may not respecify this one.

verdict_rules.PASS_TO_FINAL_EVALUATION: All structural-selection and identifiability gates pass; the frozen fiscal-augmented form may be evaluated on the final window.
verdict_rules.FAIL_BEFORE_HOLDOUT: Any required structural-selection or identifiability gate fails; final holdout stays unopened.
verdict_rules.CANDIDATE_AFTER_FINAL_EVALUATION: The frozen form passes final predictive gates but remains a non-causal candidate; separate validation and SD activation gates are still required.
verdict_rules.REJECT_TESTED_FORM: The frozen fiscal-augmented form fails decisively on permitted evaluation. This rejects this form, not the possibility that sovereign yields respond to fiscal conditions under another separately preregistered specification.

estimation_authorization.next_gate: Implement an offline selection runner that exactly enforces this frozen contract, add tests, and only then explicitly open a bounded structural-selection execution. Contract creation itself must not estimate coefficients.
